players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.detail: Key passes: 4 (top quarter of forwards: 2+); 3 assists, 4 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Match-winning impact
strengths.coach: Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 23/33 passes (70%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Strong forward performance (8.8, top 25% for the position) - best at getting shots off, chance creation; work on shot selection, forcing passes.

coach.opener: PhogsToffees, a 8.8. That's top-25% forward work, and it didn't happen by accident.
coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 50% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Outstanding midfielder performance (8.7, top 10% for the position) - best at goal threat; work on passing accuracy, tackle timing.

coach.opener: Well, BellyTb1, a 8.7 is the kind of night you tell your grandkids about. Top 10% of midfielders, and you earned every bit.
coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

players.name: tuxedo_slide

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 10/21 passes (48%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 3 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.2, below average for the position) - work on defensive work rate, forcing passes.

coach.opener: A 7.2 today, tuxedo_slide. Little below the line for a midfielder, but there's good stuff in here to work with.
coach.closer: I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you.

talk.opener: That's a W. 4-2 against pijany, and I'm smiling so big it hurts.

well.title: Scoring
